_comment: Runtime advisories accepted by the CI Audit job (.github/scripts/audit-gate.mjs). Each entry needs the GHSA id, the package path, and why it can't be fixed here. Remove an entry when the advisory stops being reported; the job fails until you do.

advisories.reason: No fixed toml release, and every mdx-bundler 3.x pulls it in. The chain only parses TOML frontmatter in our own MDX at build time, never request input.
